D: A broke Depression-era boxer makes an unlikely comeback to keep his family together.
P: Serve the mains when the Braddocks sit down to their thin family dinner.
S: the salami his son takes and James makes him give back
Salami sliced thin and fanned out with crusty bread, cold butter and pickled onions, bought and paid for this time.
making a little go a long way
Thick slices of white bread fried slowly in hot beef dripping until golden and crisp on both sides, drained, sprinkled with flaky salt and cracked pepper, served hot.
the fight crowd at the big arena
Franks simmered 5 minutes, in steamed buns with yellow mustard and warm sauerkraut with caraway, wrapped in wax paper like a 1930s fight night.
M: Mae making one pot feed the whole family
Beef shin browned, onion, carrot, potato and barley, stock and thyme, simmered 3 hours until thick. Bread.
the first proper meal after a win
Rib eye seasoned and seared in a hot pan, butter basted, rested, with buttery mashed potato, peas and a gravy made from the pan juices and stock.
W: Day-old bread torn into a buttered dish with sultanas, soaked 20 minutes in a custard of eggs, milk, brown sugar and cinnamon, baked at 170C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden.
K: the milk they can barely afford in the Depression
Cold full cream milk in small glasses, or warmed with a spoon of honey and cinnamon on a cold night.

s.note: the salami his son takes and James makes him give back
s.how: Slice 150g salami thin and fan it out with a crusty loaf, cold butter and a jar of pickled onions. Bought and paid for this time, with a little left over.

s.note: making a little go a long way
s.how: Heat 100g beef dripping in a heavy pan. Fry 8 thick slices white bread slowly until golden and crisp on both sides. Drain and sprinkle with flaky salt and cracked pepper. Serve hot.

m.note: Mae making one pot feed the whole family
m.how: Brown 800g diced beef shin. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 400g potatoes, 100g pearl barley and 1.2L stock with thyme. Simmer 3 hours until thick. Serve with bread to make it go further.

w.how: Tear 8 slices day-old bread into a buttered dish and scatter with 80g sultanas. Whisk 3 eggs, 500ml milk, 60g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon and pour over. Soak 20 minutes and bake at 170C for 40 minutes.

d.note: the milk they can barely afford in the Depression
d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into small glasses. On a cold night, warm it gently with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of cinnamon until steaming.
